title: More Items Craftings
description: A datapack to add a little more craftings for vanilla items to the game
body:
This data pack adds a little bit extension to the game by adding some craftings for items that were uncraftable before.

### Here is the list of items
- **Saddle** | 3x Leather, 2x String, 2x Iron Ingot
  
  ![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1ae4ed6c358b7758c41a73418013499c8fb776ba.png)
- **Elytra** | 2x Feather, 1x String, 4x Phantom Membrane, 1x Dragon Breath

  ![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/faacf334d56249dd369b11be27df166321025356.png)
- **Chainmail armor** (helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots) | 4x-8x-5x-4x Chain


- **Name Tag** | 3x Paper, 1x Ink Sac, 1x String

  ![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/be446806867990236ca85e1d08b80b38467fb2d3.png)
